name: Message

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Point toward creature; whispered message and whispered reply; 120 feet; solid barriers permit only familiar target with known location; magical silence and specified materials block; no unrelated listeners.

rules.text: You point toward a creature within range and whisper a message.
The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.
You can cast this spell through solid objects if you are familiar with the target and know it is beyond the barrier.
Magical silence; 1 foot of stone, metal, or wood; or a thin sheet of lead blocks the spell.
